meta.source: market_cache 'bot_snapshot_<date>': the Telegram bot's 5 rotate-in and 5 rotate-out picks per day, saved at the time
meta.method: Return from the pick day's Binance close to 7 and 30 days later, minus the median listed coin over the same days. Rotate-in is right when it beat the median, rotate-out when it trailed it.
